name: g6-receive
purpose: G6 business journey (seed -> UI -> SQL assert -> cleanup). Extends receive-navigation.json. Data layer only: seeds a vNhapTP worklist row and QC slots; the QR scan itself is not automated yet.

scenario.title: Nhap kho: seed phieu san xuat -> hien tren vNhapTP
scenario.description: Seed B20Item + 2 dong B30AccDoc (LOT 20 ky tu) + kho/ke/2 slot QC voi tien to {{prefix}}; mo man hinh Nhap thanh pham - QR; SQL xac nhan dong worklist trong dbo.vNhapTP (SL san xuat 20, SL da nhap 0, 2 slot trong); cleanup ve Remaining = 0. Buoc quet QR tem tong (FormEnterItemSV) CHUA tu dong hoa - dung qr.sql de lay chuoi QR va quet tay, xem docs/QC_LIVE_SEED_DATA.md.
